**Disregarding the nigh impossible statistics winning the lottery in this post.**

Although many of us are so unfortunately delusional to spend hundreds or even thousands of dollars upon tickets, the lottery is not as simple as it is portrayed to be. It isn't just limited to being one of the many streams of revenue that the government utilizes to garner cash from the uninformed or desperate.

It is more than simply a "stupid tax" that many, including myself have stipulated it to be. Many of us may say that "I would do X with that amount of money, portion Y into this, Z into etc. Yet deep within our minds, even discussed among friends, we are fooling no one. We would also be lying to most of ourselves when we say "Oh, that money would never change **me****, because I am different. Or something along the lines of "I'm a good person who would use that money for altruistic, non hedonistic purposes." **Let me be clear. You are not different. **

The reason *why* you can so easily say such nonsense is because you yourself have not actually won that money. You **know** that unless that delusional fantasy is realized, the "I've won the lotto personality" will never truly be shown. Don't lie: even if you're self-employed, you may still have a business to garner more revenue for yourself, and certainly a lump sum payday such as the lottery would be deemed good as well by you. There is virtually NO ONE who would not want to win the lottery; the few who say otherwise are astronomically insignificant when viewing society as a whole.

The whole concept of the lottery is about power. It is about how we as humans crave so desperately to escape from constant struggle and monotony of our daily lives, to be our own masters. To not care about anything else other than obtain the greatest gain for ourselves. It is the ultimate mirror which reveals the true person from within ourselves. It shows us that once we have that type of money, your friends, family, everyone around you is considered expendable and nothing should stand in your way.

All of us are one ticket away from showing our true colors. Think about that before you waste *even the time* to buy a lottery ticket. I guarantee that this will be a better investment for you and everyone close to you, as you may be one ticket away from discovering something you and your loved ones wished you hadn't.
The concept of the Powerball lottery, or any lottery for that matter is more than a "stupid tax."
It's more of a poor tax, trickling the money back up.

disregarding the jackpot altogether. MOST states that collect lottery gains (and it IS a profitable business) use that money to support local school systems that are in low property value areas. this allows the state to fund education to the impoverished. the odds of winning are negligible, but it provides real world benefits to children that will grow to become future citizens. by purchasing a lottery ticket i am giving to charity, and giving hope to children who are poor of no fault of their own. and in doing so, i purchase hope. you see, i DREAM of winning the lottery, and buy buying that little piece of paper, i have purchased a good dream for the night, a tiny hope of riches, and hope for those youths in my community that i cannot afford to directly help.

as such, i have every reason to purchase a lottery ticket. not because i might win (i almost certainly won't), but because hope is worth that couple dollars. so call me a hedonist if you will, but i care about my community.
